name: Everything Will Be Ok
overview: Scripture assures believers that trusting in the LORD brings peace and provision, as He is our Shepherd who meets all our needs. When we seek the LORD, He hears us and delivers us from fear, empowering us to face life's challenges without dread because He is on our side. Trusting wholeheartedly in God rather than relying on our own understanding renews our strength and sustains us through trials. God’s presence promises help, strength, and steadfast support, affirming that everything will be okay when we rest in His righteous care.
